title: Chiti ki cheekh, chiti ka dil (An-Naml 27:18)

lines.line: Chiti ke paas zabaan nahi hoti. Lekin khatra aaye, toh wo bhi *chillati* hai.

options.layout: top/bottom split: creator top, macro ant below
options.visual: 0.0: creator on screen, speaking; bottom half is real macro footage of one ant, head-on, antennae already twitching (Pexels/Pixabay free licence). 'zabaan' sits big in the serif beside the creator: NO TONGUE. 1.4: hard cut in the lower half to the ant's open mandibles in extreme close-up. 2.8 ('khatra'): lower half cuts to a shadow sweeping over a line of ants, they scatter. 3.8 ('chillati'): the word SCREAMS lands big, the ants freeze.
options.sound: voice from frame 0; soft low thud at 2.8 when the shadow falls
options.why: Frame 0 = a face plus a giant ant head: reads at 270 px. Four picture beats before 4 s, all real footage. The contradiction (no tongue, still screams) is in the first 4 words.

options.layout: creator full screen, ant footage cut-outs around
options.visual: 0.0: creator full frame; a macro ant cut-out walks across the lower third. 1.4: a second, bigger ant freezes by the creator's shoulder. 2.8: a cut-out ant opens its jaws towards camera. 3.8: SCREAMS set in the serif beside the head.
options.sound: voice; a tiny tick as each ant lands
options.why: Keeps the face biggest and friendly, but cut-out ants over a talking head can look like stickers (STYLE.md tells); weaker frame 0 than A.

options.layout: creator in a circle over full-screen macro footage
options.visual: 0.0: full-screen macro of an ant colony at a nest entrance, creator in a lower-left circle. 1.4: cut to one ant lifting its head. 2.8: cut to ants racing out of the hole. 3.8: SCREAMS over the swarm.
options.sound: voice; rising soft rumble under the swarm
options.why: Most cinematic picture, but the creator is small at frame 0, so the thumbnail reads as a nature clip, not our channel.

lines.line: Bas uski cheekh awaaz nahi, ek *khushboo* hoti hai.

options.layout: top/bottom split continues; the lower half turns into the scent graphic
options.visual: 4.5 ('awaaz nahi'): in the lower half a sound-wave line under the ant flattens to nothing. 5.6 ('khushboo'): from the ant's head a soft amber haze blooms outward in rings over the real footage. KHUSHBOO / SCENT appears small beside the creator.
options.sound: a soft 'sniff' air sound on 'khushboo', no music hit
options.why: Two more beats before 6 s and the hook's answer is drawn: the amber scent becomes the reel's accent colour for the whole video.

options.layout: full-screen macro, creator off
options.visual: 4.5: full screen, one ant in extreme macro; a muted speaker icon crosses out... 5.6: amber haze rises off its head.
options.why: Strong image, but taking the creator off before 6 s breaks the 2–3 s rule only if line 1 runs short; also the speaker icon is close to a template tell.

options.layout: creator full screen, haze graphic beside
options.visual: 4.5: creator full frame, an amber haze rises from the bottom edge beside them; 5.6: the word scent written in the serif in the haze.
options.why: Simple and calm, but only one beat and no real ant: weak against the 1.5 s rule.

lines.line: Khatra mehsoos hote hi, wo hawa mein ek chemical chhod deti hai.

options.layout: full-screen macro footage, creator off
options.visual: A real ant in macro, head raised; an amber cloud animates out of its head (drawn over the footage, low opacity, grain), drifting on the air.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.why: Shows exactly what the line says, on a real ant; the drawn scent is labelled with the real term once.

options.layout: full-screen scientific illustration on the reel's sand ground
options.visual: A clean drawn ant in profile; the head glands light amber; dots drift out into the air.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.why: Clear and calm, but a drawing after a real ant hook is a step down; use it only if no good macro clip is found.

lines.line: Scientist E. O. Wilson ne 1958 mein ise naapa tha. Paas wali chitiyan, chaar se nau second mein alert.

options.layout: real artifact first: the 1958 paper, then the measure
options.visual: Cut to the first page of Wilson's 1958 Psyche paper (scan from the Psyche archive; licence to check), the title underlined as 'Wilson' is said; small photo of E. O. Wilson (Wikimedia Commons, licence to check) beside. On 'chaar se nau second': split into a top-down nest diagram: a drop at the centre, a 5 cm ring, a stopwatch counting 0 → 4 → 9 s while nearby ants turn amber.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958) · harvester ant, lab test
options.sound: page turn, then a quiet clock tick
options.why: A real paper beats a typed claim (STYLE.md); the ring and the timer make 'how fast' felt, not just said.

options.layout: creator full screen with a headroom card
options.visual: The creator speaks; a small card in the headroom shows the paper's title and 'within four to nine seconds' underlined as spoken.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.why: Keeps the face in the middle of the science, but the paper is tiny and the speed is not shown.

lines.line: Phir wo bhi wahi khushboo chhodti hain. Aur dekhte hi dekhte, poora bil jaag jaata hai.

options.layout: full-screen top-down nest map (drawn), creator off
options.visual: Top-down cut-away of a nest: tunnels and chambers in sand tones, dozens of ant dots. One amber dot at the entrance; the amber spreads dot to dot as a wave through the tunnels until the whole nest glows ('poora bil jaag jaata hai').
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.sound: a soft rising swell under the spread
options.why: This is the reel's key motion graphic: the chain reaction cannot be filmed, but drawn it is understood in 3 seconds.

options.layout: full-screen real footage
options.visual: Real footage of ants pouring out of a nest entrance after a disturbance.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.why: Real and lively, but it shows the result, not the scent passing from ant to ant.

options.layout: circle over the nest map
options.visual: Same nest map as A, with the creator in a small circle top-left reacting.
options.tag: Established science · E. O. Wilson, Psyche 65 (1958)
options.why: Adds the creator's reaction; use if the creator has been off screen for more than ~8 s.

lines.line: Ab yahi manzar Quran mein dekho. Surah Naml mein.

options.layout: creator full screen, a real Mushaf close-up as a cut-in
options.visual: Creator to camera on 'Ab yahi manzar Quran mein dekho'; on 'Surah Naml' cut to a real Mushaf close-up, a finger on the line (we film our own Mushaf), with 'An-Naml · Surah 27' small on the margin.
options.tag: Quranic context
options.why: Marks the turn from science to Quran with a real object we own; the creator returns after the science run.

options.layout: creator full screen only
options.visual: Creator to camera, slow push-in; the surah name in the serif in the headroom.
options.tag: Quranic context
options.why: Calm reset, but no visual beat for ~3 s.

lines.line: Sulaiman alaihissalam ki fauj ek waadi se guzar rahi thi. Chitiyon ki waadi.

options.layout: full-screen 3D valley (our terrain tooling), no people
options.visual: A generic, unnamed rocky valley in 3D (RECONSTRUCTION), low dawn light; dust rises on the far ridge and rolls down: the army is shown only as dust and a long moving shadow, never as figures. On 'chitiyon ki waadi' the camera drops to ground level among ant hills.
options.tag: RECONSTRUCTION
options.sound: a distant low rumble of marching, building
options.why: Tells the scene without depicting a Prophet or soldiers (SERIES.md rules) and without naming a disputed place (Sham vs Ta'if); the drop to ant level sets up the ant's view.

options.layout: full-screen real footage + sound
options.visual: Real low-angle macro of ants on sandy ground; the ground trembles slightly and dust drifts across; the rumble does the storytelling.
options.why: Cheaper and real, but loses the sense of a great army approaching.

lines.line: Tabhi ek chiti boli,

options.layout: full-screen macro, one ant raises its head
options.visual: Cut to one ant on a pebble, head lifting towards camera; a faint amber breath leaves its head (callback to the science).
options.sound: silence under the rumble for half a second
options.why: A short beat that makes 'one ant' the hero and ties the Quran's scene to the scent we just learned.

options.layout: creator full screen, leaning in
options.visual: Creator lowers their voice for 'Tabhi ek chiti boli'; slight push-in.
options.why: Storyteller moment, but the line is short; better kept on the ant.

lines.line: "Ae chitiyo, apne gharon mein chali jao.

options.layout: Ayah card (torn paper on the sand ground), the words lit as spoken
options.visual: Ayah card with 27:18 from src/data/quran (Arabic), the phrase udkhulu masakinakum ringed in amber as 'apne gharon mein chali jao' is spoken; the English meaning under it.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: The Quran's own words on screen at the moment they are spoken; ring = our one mark with meaning.

options.layout: full-screen macro, ants running into a hole, Ayah as a lower band
options.visual: Real footage of ants filing into a nest entrance; the Arabic phrase as a slim band at y ≈ 1150.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: Picture matches the words, but real ants often attack rather than hide, so the footage may imply a science claim we don't make.

lines.line: Kahin Sulaiman aur unka lashkar tumhe kuchal na de... aur unhe *pata bhi na chale*."

options.layout: same Ayah card, push-in to the last phrase
options.visual: Card stays; the ring moves to wa hum la yash'urun, which is underlined slowly and held; the dust and rumble return behind the card.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.sound: rumble swells, then stops dead after 'pata bhi na chale'
options.why: Plants the payoff phrase visually now, so its return in line 14 is recognised.

options.layout: split: Ayah card top, dust/shadow over ants below
options.visual: Top half the card; bottom half the army's shadow sliding over the ant hills.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: Shows the danger and the words together, but halves the card's size.

lines.line: Khatra dekha, sabko khabar kar di. Bilkul asli chitiyon ki tarah.

options.layout: split: Quran scene top, the nest map below
options.visual: Top: the ant on the pebble (line 8 shot). Bottom: the nest map from line 5 lights up again, amber wave. Both halves pulse together on 'Bilkul asli chitiyon ki tarah'.
options.tag: Established science + Quranic context
options.why: Puts the Quran's scene and the science side by side: this is where the two halves of the reel meet.

options.layout: creator full screen
options.visual: Creator to camera, a small inset of the nest map in the headroom.
options.tag: Established science
options.why: Personal, but the comparison is less visible.

lines.line: Aur Allah ke diye ilm se, Sulaiman ne uski baat samajh li.

options.layout: creator full screen, calm
options.visual: Creator to camera; '27:16' small in the headroom with 'taught the speech of birds' as a one-line note.
options.tag: Quranic context · An-Naml 27:16
options.why: Clean statement of what the reel does NOT claim (no science test of Sulaiman's understanding). The creator's face carries trust here.

options.layout: Ayah card 27:16
options.visual: Short Ayah card for 27:16 (fetched), the phrase 'ullimna mantiq at-tayr' ringed.
options.text: “We have been taught the speech of birds”
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:16 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: Sources the line on screen, but a second card this close can feel heavy.

lines.line: Lekin is kahani ka sabse khoobsurat hissa abhi baaki hai.

options.layout: creator full screen, the music drops out; small follow card (mid-video CTA)
options.visual: Creator leans in; the bed music fades to near silence. A small Instagram/Facebook follow card slides into the headroom for 2.5 s (Cta 'follow', placement top).
options.sound: music out; the silence is the cue
options.why: A calm moment after a mini-payoff (about 45% in) is where the CTA rules want the mid-video follow, and the silence makes the turn felt.

options.layout: creator full screen, no CTA
options.visual: Same, without the follow card.
options.why: If the creator prefers the mid-video CTA after line 17 instead.

lines.line: Uski aakhri baat phir se suno. "Unhe pata bhi na chale."

options.layout: the Ayah card returns, the phrase alone
options.visual: The 27:18 card again, everything faded except wa hum la yash'urun, now large; the English 'and they will not even know' set as a serif pull quote below.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: Recognition: the viewer saw this ring in line 10; now it is the whole frame.

options.layout: pull quote beside the creator's circle
options.visual: PullQuote overlay: the English line big in the serif beside the creator's circle, the Arabic small above.
options.tag: Quranic text · An-Naml 27:18 · tr. Mufti Taqi Usmani
options.why: Built component (PullQuote.tsx), keeps the face; slightly less dramatic than A.

lines.line: Poori qaum ki jaan khatre mein thi. Phir bhi usne fauj ko *zaalim* nahi kaha.

options.layout: full-screen macro, slow motion
options.visual: Slow-motion macro of the ant on the pebble as the army's shadow reaches it; 'zaalim' set small in the serif, then struck through with one hand-drawn line.
options.tag: Tafsir · al-Qurtubi
options.why: The danger is felt again while the line says she did not accuse; the one strike-through is a mark with meaning, not decoration.

options.layout: creator full screen
options.visual: Creator to camera, emotional delivery, slow push.
options.why: Lets the creator carry the emotion; fine if the slow-motion clip isn't good enough.

lines.line: Bas itna kaha, wo jaan boojh kar aisa nahi karenge.

options.layout: creator full screen
options.visual: Creator to camera; the words 'not on purpose' appear softly in the serif beside them.
options.tag: Tafsir · al-Qurtubi
options.why: A short human line; the face should say it.

options.layout: full-screen macro continues
options.visual: The ant stays on screen; the shadow passes over without harming it.
options.why: Visual relief, but the face gives the line more warmth.

lines.line: Imam Qurtubi likhte hain, kuch ulama ke mutabiq Sulaiman isi baat par muskuraye the.

options.layout: real artifact: a printed page of Tafsir al-Qurtubi
options.visual: A printed Arabic page of al-Jami' li-Ahkam al-Quran at this passage (scan from archive.org or a library, licence to check), the phrase on Sulaiman's smile highlighted as spoken; credit line below.
options.text: Some scholars: he smiled at this
options.tag: Tafsir · al-Qurtubi, al-Jami' li-Ahkam al-Quran, on 27:18–19
options.why: A real source on screen makes 'kuch ulama ke mutabiq' visible and honest (STYLE.md: real artifact first).

options.layout: pull quote beside the creator's circle
options.visual: PullQuote: 'Some said his smile was joy at her words.' with the credit 'al-Qurtubi, on 27:18–19'.
options.text: Some said his smile was joy at her words.
options.tag: Tafsir (a reported view) · al-Qurtubi
options.why: Use if no scan with a usable licence is found.

lines.line: Ek chhoti si chiti, aur itna bada *dil*.

options.layout: full-screen macro, the ant small in a large frame
options.visual: Wide macro: one tiny ant on a big stone, lots of empty space; 'itna bada dil' as one phrase in the serif.
options.text: Such a small ant. Such a big heart.
options.why: Scale contrast makes the line literal; empty space is calm and premium.

options.layout: creator full screen
options.visual: Creator smiles to camera.
options.why: Warm, but the picture adds nothing.

lines.line: Aur hum? Kisi ka reply thoda late aa jaaye, toh dimaag mein poori kahani bana lete hain.

options.layout: creator full screen + a phone mock beside
options.visual: Creator to camera; beside them a plain phone screen (our own design, no real app UI) shows a chat with 'typing…' then 'seen', and three thought bubbles stack up as 'poori kahani' is said.
options.tag: Reflection
options.why: Brings the lesson into the viewer's life; a little humour after the emotion. No real app branding.

options.layout: creator full screen only
options.visual: Creator to camera, a raised eyebrow on 'Aur hum?'.
options.why: The delivery alone may land the joke.

lines.line: Science ne chiti ki *cheekh* naapi. Quran ne uska *dil* dikhaya.

options.layout: two-part card on the sand ground, then hold 2 s
options.visual: Left-aligned, two lines in the serif: 'Science measured her scream.' (with the amber nest map faint behind) then 'The Quran showed her heart.' (with the Ayah phrase faint behind). Held still for 2 s.
options.text: Science measured her scream. / The Quran showed her heart.
options.tag: Reflection
options.why: The quotable line gets the whole frame and a dead-still hold (QUALITY.md §2: last line holds 2 s).

options.layout: creator full screen, line set beside
options.visual: Creator to camera; the two lines beside them as a pull quote.
options.text: Science measured her scream. / The Quran showed her heart.
options.tag: Reflection
options.why: Keeps the face for the last line; the type is smaller.

lines.line: Aisi aayatein aur samajhni hain? Toh follow kar lo.

options.layout: end card: follow + comment ask
options.visual: Cta 'follow' end card in the caption band with the real Instagram and Facebook icons, then the engage card with the comment question.
options.text: Follow · Have you ever overthought a late reply?
options.why: Follow on the spoken CTA; a specific, easy comment question tied to the reel's lesson.

options.layout: end card: follow only
options.visual: Follow card only.
options.why: Shorter end; loses the comment prompt.
